envelope.description: The full index rebuilds a repository from scratch and records its state

body.title: The full index rebuilds a repository from scratch and records its state
body.summary: fullIndex (src/indexer/index.ts:606-768): return incoming relationships to pending, delete the repository's rows in both stores (deleteEntitiesForRepo with the option, deleteUnresolvedForRepo; document summaries and exploration cache go too and doc-summarise-repo regenerates the summaries), reset IndexState (generation advanced, fullIndexFinished false), index every selected file with cleanFirst semantics, so indexFile's unchanged-hash skip (src/indexer/index.ts:1031-1036) does not apply, record uncommittedFiles for a thrown error or a false return, store the repository entity before indexManifest, run the cross-file pass in 'full' mode, set endpointPassFailed and fullIndexFinished. Daemon start-up queues a full index for every repository whose fullIndexFinished is false (beside today's rule in src/indexer/index.ts:286-300). Anchors: fullIndex is the private method at src/indexer/index.ts:606-768; it calls indexFile(filePath, repoPath, false) (:655), and indexFile skips a file whose stored hash is unchanged unless cleanFirst (:1031-1036) and returns false on a read failure (:1027-1029), which the loop counts as skipped (:656); the start-up rule that queues full indexes is in src/indexer/index.ts:286-300 (enqueue at :300). Depends on t2 (state), t8 and t9 (the 'full' pass), t10 (the delete with return to pending and export_names cleanup). It changes fullIndex's call at src/indexer/index.ts:707 to pass mode 'full'.
acceptanceChecks: ac2 integration: a store with a hand-deleted cross-file edge and unchanged hashes gets the edge back from repo.reindex
A file whose read fails during a full index is in uncommittedFiles and the repository reads not complete
DEPENDS_ON edges from the repository entity are stored for a manifest fixture
A full index made to throw part-way leaves fullIndexFinished false, and start-up queues that repository
Repository B's reindex restores repository A's hand-written edge into B through Pass 0 without reindexing A
After a reindex of the ac3 fixture no export_names entry remains under an old u64 and calls through the barrel still resolve

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/full-index-rebuild.test.ts: hand-deleted edge restored by repo.reindex (mutation: unchanged-hash skip kept), unreadable file in uncommittedFiles, repository entity and DEPENDS_ON stored, interruption leaves fullIndexFinished false and start-up queues it, cross-repository restore without reindexing A, no export_names under old u64s after reindex
